subject.title: refactor(gateway-protocol): derive schema registries from owner fragments

question: After rebasing this maintainer-labeled protocol refactor onto current `main`, should it land only if registry, generated-client, and package-export parity remain unchanged?
rationale: The refactor changes the assembly path for a public protocol registry; repository policy requires explicit maintainer handling for the protected label, and the existing proof predates the current main head.

options.title: Rebase and refresh parity proof
options.body: Recommended: rebase onto current `main` and land only after the registry guard plus generated JSON, Swift, Kotlin, and packed-export parity checks pass on the integration head.

options.title: Accept existing-head proof
options.body: Land using the existing proof if the maintainer accepts the small integration uncertainty introduced by base drift.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Pause if current protocol work makes a broad registry restructuring undesirable at this time.

recommendation.title: Rebase and refresh parity proof
recommendation.body: Recommended: rebase onto current `main` and land only after the registry guard plus generated JSON, Swift, Kotlin, and packed-export parity checks pass on the integration head.
